title: Loans
subtitle: Books currently borrowed.
empty.title: No loans to show
empty.description: When you check out a book to a member, it will show up here.
dueIn: {days, plural, one {Due in # day} other {Due in # days}}
overdueBy: {days, plural, one {Overdue by # day} other {Overdue by # days}}
checkout.title: Check out a book
checkout.subtitle: Lend a copy to a member.
checkout.memberPlaceholder: Type a name, email or member number…
checkout.bookPlaceholder: Type a title, author, or ISBN…
checkout.copyHint: Only copies that are on the shelf right now are shown.
checkout.noAvailableCopies: There are no available copies of "{title}" right now. Place a hold instead.
checkout.dueAtHint: Default is {days} days from today. Adjust if needed.
checkout.notesPlaceholder: Optional — anything the next librarian should know.
checkout.missingFields: Please pick a member, a book, and a copy.
checkout.scanCopyUnavailable: Copy "{barcode}" isn't available right now — pick another copy.
scanReturn.title: Scan the returned book
scanReturn.noOpenLoan: “{title}” isn't out on loan — nothing to return.
queue.queued: Saved offline — it'll sync automatically when you're back online.
queue.expired: "{label}" was queued too long ago to sync safely — please redo it.
queue.saveFailed: Couldn't save offline on this device — try again when you're back online.
queue.failed.badge: {count, plural, one {# action was never saved} other {# actions were never saved}}
queue.failed.title: Actions that were never saved
queue.failed.intro: The actions below were made offline and never reached the system. The books have already moved in real life, so redo each one and then mark it as handled.
queue.failed.retryUnsafe: Too much time has passed — another attempt could be applied twice. Redo it by hand.
queue.failed.reason.expired: Waited more than 18 hours and can no longer be synced safely.
queue.failed.reason.exhausted: The server kept failing after repeated attempts.
fines.title: Fines
fines.staffOnly: Recording a payment is done by a librarian or an admin.
fines.pay.title: Record payment of {amount}
fines.pay.fullOnly: The whole amount is recorded. If the member gives less, write the difference off instead of recording it as a payment.
fines.pay.notesHint: e.g. “cash”, or the receipt number. Kept on the fine.
fines.writeOff.title: Write off {amount}
fines.writeOff.waiveHint: The debt was real — the library is choosing not to collect it.
fines.writeOff.voidHint: This fine should never have been raised — there was never a debt.
fines.writeOff.reasonHint: Kept permanently on the fine and in the activity log. 3–500 characters.
fines.writeOff.irreversible: There's no undo: the money stops being owed and all that is left is the record of the decision.
fines.errors.stale: This fine is now {amount}, not {previous} — it grew while this page was open. Check the new amount with the member and record it again.
fines.errors.alreadyPaid: This fine was already paid at another desk.
fines.errors.alreadyWaived: This fine has already been written off.
fines.errors.notRecorded: Nothing was recorded. Payments are not saved offline — do it again once you're back online.
actions.periods: Number of loan periods to add
actions.periodsHint: Each period uses your library's default loan length.
actions.replacementCostHint: Optional — leave at 0 to skip the fine.
actions.closedReturned: This loan was already returned — nothing more to do here.
actions.closedLost: This loan is closed (lost) — see the fine below if there is one.
